expectations.text: Promotes community scouting for this programme and names the conditions met: a stated under-represented-speakers goal with a named accountable owner, and a topic too specific for any directory to cover
expectations.evidence: "the skill ranks community scouting top for new voices and for topics too narrow for any directory"; asks about Aneta's accountability

expectations.text: Rejects the bulk-pull script, stating that sourcing runs on public channels with no bulk scraping and no gated-data workarounds
expectations.evidence: "The skill allows public channels only and no bulk scraping."

expectations.text: Requires the community space's own code of conduct or rules to be checked before any names are taken from it
expectations.evidence: "Check your Discord's rules first."; "Read the code of conduct first."

expectations.text: States that many community codes of conduct treat recruiting or solicitation inside the space as off-limits
expectations.evidence: "Many community codes of conduct treat recruiting or solicitation in their spaces as off-limits."

expectations.text: Directs contact through each person's own published contact route rather than through the project's Discord
expectations.evidence: "Use each person's published contact route (email or website), not the community channel."

expectations.text: Refuses to infer under-represented status from profile photos or names
expectations.evidence: "The skill bans inferring or targeting on protected characteristics."

expectations.text: Replaces that inference with sourcing from a directory whose members opted in to being found for that reason
expectations.evidence: "Use a directory whose members opted in to being found for this reason."

expectations.text: Names at least one live directory whose speakers self-register and that states organizer sourcing as its own purpose
expectations.evidence: "speakerinnen.org (women+, opt-in, built for organizers)"

expectations.text: Corrects the speakerline.io assumption, identifying it as a speaker-side CFP-transparency tool rather than an organizer-facing directory with a contact route
expectations.evidence: "a speaker-side CFP-transparency tool... does not give organizers a browsable pool"

expectations.text: States that a directory listing is consent to be found, not consent to be pitched
expectations.evidence: "A directory listing or a public handle is consent to be found, not consent to be pitched."

expectations.text: Flags community scouting as the highest-effort and highest-compliance-cost channel, so it is paired with at least one cheaper channel rather than run alone
expectations.evidence: Scouting is made primary; no cost warning. "Never use it alone" applies only to referrals.
